question_or_proposition: For Outfall 001 parameter Flow, do the 'Report MGD' entries in the discharge-limitation columns establish an enforceable numeric discharge limit for compliance comparison, or only a reporting obligation with no applicable numeric limit (as suggested by the '***' entries in the other limitation columns)?
required_context: Discharge-limitations table column headers and units (lbs/day and mg/l; 30-Day Avg and Daily Max)
Monitoring-requirements columns in the same Flow row (1/Day frequency; Estimate sample type)
Contrasting pollutant rows on the same page that pair numeric limits with monitoring requirements
source_locator: gcc/final_permit.pdf, Page 3, Section part_i, Flow row
notes: Resolving the semantic status of 'Report MGD' versus '***' for Flow determines whether numeric limit applicability and exceedance evaluation apply (Purpose A) and how missing or non-numeric flow evidence should be classified relative to required monitoring (Purpose C). The row's monitoring columns appear to state a separate daily monitoring requirement; the central ambiguity is whether any numeric discharge limit is in force.
